target.title: feat(google): add Antigravity agy auth bridge
target.body:
## Summary

This PR adds first-class `google-antigravity` support through the Antigravity `agy --print` runtime and tightens the surrounding Google provider boundary.

Provider split:

- `google-antigravity` uses the signed-in Antigravity / `agy` session.
- `google-gemini-cli` uses the official Gemini CLI local account cache.
- `google` remains the Gemini key-based provider.

OpenClaw does not own the Antigravity session. It detects the provider-owned session and delegates execution to `agy`.

## What Problem This Solves

OpenClaw already separates the Google provider paths, but it did not have a first-class Antigravity route. Users with a signed-in Antigravity / `agy` session could not route OpenClaw model execution through Antigravity without mixing that path into the Gemini CLI or standard Google provider flows.

This PR adds `google-antigravity` as a provider-owned CLI runtime path. OpenClaw delegates Antigravity execution to `agy --print`, keeps Antigravity session ownership outside OpenClaw, and preserves separation from the existing Google provider paths.

## What Changed

### Antigravity

- Added bundled `google-antigravity` provider registration.
- Added a `google-antigravity` CLI backend.
- Routed Antigravity prompts through `agy --print` with a bounded print timeout.
- Added setup support for a local `google-antigravity:antigravity-session` profile.
- Added runtime session resolution for the Antigravity app-session profile.
- Added provider aliases, model policy wiring, docs, and live-testing notes.

### Gemini CLI and shared provider boundary

- Added official Gemini CLI local account import support for `google-gemini-cli`.
- Changed Gemini CLI setup to import the official cache instead of launching an OpenClaw-owned browser flow.
- Required validated active Google account identity before saving or using imported Gemini CLI data.
- Failed closed on missing or mismatched Gemini CLI account identity.
- Added provider-owned CLI backend resolution.
- Preserved generic fallback forwarding only when no provider-owned hook exists.
- Preserved backend allowlist checks before and after provider resolution.
- Fixed CLI runner cleanup gaps on mid-prepare failures.
- Updated Plugin SDK exports, API baseline, and CLI backend docs.

## Evidence

**Real environment tested:** PR #99733 head `94a894f4a09d95750823a30464afe2a6a13c0910` on the local OpenClaw checkout with a clean working tree at proof start.

**Exact steps or command run after this patch:** Direct Antigravity CLI control, sterile-home Antigravity CLI control, OpenClaw live runtime through `pnpm openclaw qa manual`, and `pnpm exec tsx scripts/proof-google-auth-replacement.ts`.

**Evidence after fix:**

- Direct Antigravity CLI control passed with response `PR99733_CA21_AGY_DIRECT_OK`.
- Sterile-home Antigravity CLI control passed with response `PR99733_CA21_AGY_STERILE_OK`.
- OpenClaw live runtime passed for `google-antigravity/gemini-3-flash` with status `ok` and response `PR99733_CA21_OPENCLAW_AGY_OK`.
- Auth-boundary proof passed and verified provider-hook registration, fallback separation, Gemini CLI account import, isolated staging, inherited environment clearing, redacted output, resolver-derived profile homes, and no raw profile ids in the staged home.

**Observed result after fix:** OpenClaw routed `google-antigravity/gemini-3-flash` through the `agy --print` runtime and received the exact expected live response from the backend.

**What was not tested:**

- I did not run the full repository test suite.
- I did not prove successful Gemini CLI model generation with the live account.
- I did not prove standard Google provider live generation on this machine.
- I did not prove model-specific Antigravity selection through `agy --model`; this proof shows OpenClaw routes `google-antigravity/gemini-3-flash` through the `agy --print` runtime and receives the expected live response.
- The targeted gateway live harness is not claimed here. The product/runtime proof is captured with `pnpm openclaw qa manual`, which reaches the actual `google-antigravity` backend and returns the expected response.

## Validation

Focused validation was run locally before this live-proof refresh:

    pnpm test extensions/google/index-harness-registration.test.ts extensions/google/setup-api.test.ts extensions/google/index.test.ts src/agents/cli-backends.test.ts src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.test.ts src/agents/model-provider-auth.worker.test.ts src/agents/model-catalog.test.ts
    pnpm check:test-types
    pnpm plugin-sdk:surface:check
    git diff --check

Result: passed for the focused Vitest and type/surface/diff checks that were run.

The Plugin SDK API baseline was regenerated after the API check reported baseline drift, and the generated baseline update is included in the current PR branch.

## Tests

AI-assisted: yes.
